request.raw_text: Hi , Please create a filling system on the radiator , including a pouring section and a cap.

aim.primary_aim: The radiator shall contain a filling system comprising a pouring section and a cap.

functional_design_intentions.name: Radiator filling
functional_design_intentions.description: Provide access through which the radiator can be filled.

functional_design_intentions.name: Filling access closure
functional_design_intentions.description: Provide a cap for closing the filling system after filling.

targets_to_change.reference_geometry: pouring section of the filling system on the radiator
cap of the filling system on the radiator

required_relationships.reference: pouring section of the radiator filling system

targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the radiator geometry except where interface changes are necessary for the requested filling system.

geometry.description: A pouring section exists as part of a filling system on the radiator.
A cap exists for the radiator filling system and corresponds to its pouring section.

relationships.reference: pouring section of the radiator filling system

functions.name: Enable radiator filling
functions.description: The pouring section provides filling access to the radiator.

functions.name: Close filling access
functions.description: The cap closes the filling access associated with the pouring section.

behaviors.name: Permit filling flow
behaviors.description: The pouring section permits fluid to pass into the radiator during filling.

behaviors.name: Constrain the filling opening
behaviors.description: The cap covers or closes the pouring section when the filling access is not in use.

validation_criteria.description: A pouring section is present as part of a filling system on the radiator.
A cap is present and corresponds to the pouring section of the radiator filling system.
The pouring section provides access for filling the radiator.
The pouring section permits fluid entry into the radiator.
The cap can close the filling access associated with the pouring section.
Non-targeted radiator geometry remains unchanged except for necessary filling-system interfaces.

unresolved_requirements.description: The form, dimensions, and exact location of the pouring section on the radiator are not specified.
candidate_interpretations: a pour spout connected to the radiator

unresolved_requirements.description: The cap type, attachment method, fit, and sealing requirements are not specified.
